function: Channel estimation in the delay-Doppler domain for OTFS: the network extracts the embedded pilot from data and noise interference to estimate the DD channel (p. 1-2).
system: Single-link OTFS with scalar DD input-output model (antennas not stated), no RIS; 3 GHz carrier, 7.5 kHz subcarrier spacing, N=M=32 frame, one embedded pilot (p. 2, 4).
method: Deep residual attention network (residual, channel attention, position attention, attention-feature-fusion modules), supervised learning with MSE loss on simulated data labelled with true channel (p. 2-4).
data_channel: Simulated doubly selective OTFS channel, P=6 paths, random delay/Doppler, gains CN(0,1/P), parameters same as [10]; labels are ideal channel; training SNR random 0-20 dB (p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained at P=6 paths, random SNR 0-20 dB; tested at P=4-7 paths (retrained for rectangular waveform and fractional Doppler) and varying pilot-to-data power (p. 5).
baselines: Non-learned: LS, OMP, SBL. Learned: DRSN [10] (self-adaptive-threshold deep residual shrinkage network); ablations CAM, PAM, AFF variants (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, versus number of paths and versus pilot-to-data power ratio; trainable parameters and FLOPs (p. 4-6).
complexity: Table I: DRAN 6.6 M trainable parameters and 6.78 GMac versus DRSN 52.72 M and 53.88 GMac (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "The delay time and Doppler velocity corresponding to each path is randomly generated" (custom doubly selective simulator, gains CN(0,1/P)); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 5: "only trained under P=6 and random SNR, the framework exhibits a strong" adaptability to other path counts (Fig. 7 tests P=4 to 7); retraining for the rectangular waveform does not count.
q3_support: p. 4: "DRAN outperforms the DRSN for utilizing the CAM, PAM and AFF"; DRSN [10] is the earlier learned OTFS estimator, LS, OMP and SBL are the non-learned baselines, all compared on NMSE (Fig. 3).
q4_support: p. 5: "PARAMETERS AND FLOPS COMPARISON" (Table I, read from the page image): DRAN 6.6 M parameters and 6.78 GMac, against DRSN 52.72 M and 53.88 GMac.
q5_support: p. 4: "The training data is generated with the assumption that channel is" doubly selective, so own simulated data; no code or data link, DOI or public dataset is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included. Area 4 (OTFS channel estimation in the DD domain) wins over area 2 by specificity. Antenna configuration is not stated; the model is scalar (p. 2, Eq. 5), treated as single-antenna, which is admitted for OTFS. Table I values were read from the page image (p. 5). q2 rests on the test at P=4 to 7 paths after training at P=6 (p. 5); the retraining for the rectangular-waveform case is not counted.
